name: Courtyard by Marriott
summary: Arches, columns, cornices, a balustrade and jali screens for a hotel facade.
description: A classical front for the Courtyard by Marriott hotel in Bengaluru. Tall arched openings run along the ground floor between full-height round columns.
The entrance porch is framed by a large arch and topped with a moulded cornice and a balustrade. Beside the hotel sign, a row of geometric jali screens stands in front of the glazing.

Full-height round columns between the arches
Moulded cornice and frieze around the porch
Balustrade along the top of the porch
Geometric jali screens in front of the glazing

Arched openings and round columns along the ground floor of the hotel
Geometric jali screens beside the Courtyard by Marriott sign and green wall

name: 1 MG-Lido Mall
summary: Fluted Corinthian columns and carved ornamental panels for a mall facade.
description: A classical treatment for the facade of 1 MG-Lido Mall, a shopping mall in Bengaluru. Fluted columns with Corinthian capitals rise past two floors of glazing, set against the building's beige walls.
Between the columns, carved panels with a shell-and-scroll motif sit above and below the windows, and a white cornice runs along the top of the ground floor, above the shopfronts.

Carved shell-and-scroll panels above and below the windows
White cornice along the top of the ground floor

Column rising past two floors of glazing, with carved panels beside it
Corner of the mall with columns, a cornice and a carved panel
Fluted column with a Corinthian capital beside the shopfront

name: Royal Convention Centre
summary: A full-width jali screen across the front of a convention centre.
description: A full-width jali screen with a star pattern covers the upper front of the Royal Convention Centre, an event hall in Mysuru. At dusk the hall's lights shine through it, so the pattern glows from inside.
White pilaster panels frame the entrance and carry the centre's name, and the screen runs on either side of them above the glazed ground floor.

work.note: Star-pattern jali screen across the upper front
White pilaster panels around the entrance

photos.alt: Star-pattern jali screen on the Royal Convention Centre, lit from inside at dusk
Front of the Royal Convention Centre with the jali screen across the upper floor

name: Aero One
summary: Full-height jali screens running up a residential tower.
description: Aero One is a residential tower in Devanahalli, Bengaluru. Two continuous bands of white geometric jali run up each face, from the podium to the roof, between the rows of windows and balconies.
The bands break up the height of the tower and stand out against its darker walls.

work.note: Two full-height bands of geometric jali on each face of the tower

photos.alt: Aero One tower with two white jali bands rising from the podium to the roof
View up the corner of the tower showing the jali bands
Close view of the jali bands between rows of windows

name: KBN Hospital
summary: Arched jali panels across a hospital facade and its entrance gateway.
description: Tall jali panels with pointed-arch tops run up between the windows on both wings of KBN Hospital in Kalaburagi, whose front carries the Khaja Bandanawaz University name.
Repeated across the long white front, they give it a regular rhythm. Matching jali panels and white cladding finish the entrance gateway.

White cladding and a jali panel on the entrance gateway

photos.alt: Front of KBN Hospital with arched jali panels on both wings

name: Bismilla Green Masjid
summary: Large square-grid jali screens and calligraphy for a masjid.
description: Bismilla Green Masjid is a multi-storey masjid with a stone-coloured clad front. Large jali screens with a square grid wrap its upper floors, including a projecting bay at the front.
Arabic calligraphy stands out in relief on the cladding beside the bay, and more jali screens run along the side of the building and above the entrance.

work.note: Square-grid jali screens across the upper floors
Arabic calligraphy in relief on the front facade

photos.alt: Square-grid jali screen on the projecting front of the masjid, with calligraphy on the facade
Jali screens along the side of Bismilla Green Masjid

name: Indian Tiffin Club
summary: Full-height jali screens wrapping a restaurant building.
description: Indian Tiffin Club is a restaurant in a multi-storey building faced with white jali screens. The screens have a block pattern and rise the full height of the front and corners.
They frame open balconies hung with lanterns and planting above the entrance.

work.note: Block-pattern jali screens over the full height of the front and corners

name: Regal Jewellers
summary: A facade of arched fins framing a jewellery showroom's signage.
description: Regal Jewellers is a jewellery showroom in Bengaluru with a facade of vertical fins. Each fin has a looped, arch-shaped profile, and the arches overlap at different heights across the front, giving it depth.
The fins frame the large sign panel and the band of windows above it, over the glazed shopfront.

work.note: Vertical fins with arch-shaped profiles across the facade

photos.alt: Regal Jewellers showroom with arched fins across the facade
Arched fins around the Regal Jewellers sign

name: Infant Jesus Shrine
summary: An entrance arch with sculpted angels for a shrine.
description: The entrance arch of the Infant Jesus Shrine stands at the gate in front of the shrine buildings. Kneeling angels in relief sit at either side of the arch, which is carried on two tall pillars and topped with a cross.
The shrine's name and inscriptions in English and Tamil are set into the arch and the pillars.

work.note: Entrance arch carried on two tall pillars
Kneeling angels in relief and inscribed panels

photos.alt: Entrance arch of the Infant Jesus Shrine with kneeling angels

name: Harrow International School
summary: Balustrades, window surrounds and cornices for a red-brick school campus.
description: Harrow International School in Bengaluru has a campus of red-brick buildings. White balustrades run along the stepped garden terraces in front of them and down beside the main stairs.
White cornices and window surrounds set off the brick facades, and white columns and pediments mark the entrances.

Cornices and window surrounds on the brick facades
Columns and pediments at the entrances

name: Veterinary College
summary: Domes, cornices and window hoods for a college building.
description: The main building of the Veterinary College at Athani is a long, three-storey block with red walls. A central dome rises above the entrance, with smaller domes at the corners.
White cornice bands and window surrounds pick out each floor against the red walls, and a columned porch marks the entrance.

name: Venkatamma Ramaiah Kalyana Soudha
summary: Facade and interior mouldings for a wedding and function hall.
description: Venkatamma Ramaiah Kalyana Soudha is a wedding and function hall with a classical white front. Cornices, framed wall panels and pilasters run around the outside, and a jali screen lines the entrance porch beneath the lit name board.
Inside the hall, pilasters and mouldings frame tall windows under a coloured-glass roof.

summary: Carved window surrounds, pilasters and colonnades for an event venue.
description: Princess Golf is an event venue with classical detailing inside and out. In the hall, tall arched windows sit in carved surrounds between pilasters, under a deep moulded cornice.

name: TDP Office
summary: Columns, a pediment and a moulded cornice for a classical office building.
description: The TDP Office is a single-storey office building in a classical style. Fluted columns with capitals line the verandah, and a pediment marks the main front.
A deep cornice and frieze run all the way around the roofline, and square columns carry the pergola in the garden.

Pediment, cornice and frieze around the roofline

name: Shriram Greenfield
summary: Tall decorative panels up the corners of residential towers.
description: Shriram Greenfield is a group of residential towers at Bidarahalli, Bengaluru. Tall decorative panels with a flowing leaf pattern run up the corners and edges of each tower, from the lower floors to the roof.
Against the pale walls, the dark openings of the pattern give each tower a strong vertical line.

work.note: Leaf-pattern panels running the full height of the tower corners

name: Commercial Complex
summary: Jali screens wrapping two projecting bays of a commercial building.
description: A commercial building in Malleswaram, Bengaluru. Two projecting bays on its upper floors are wrapped in white jali screens with a star pattern, above an open ground floor.
The screens shade the floors behind them and stand out behind the trees that line the street.

work.note: Star-pattern jali screens wrapping two projecting bays

summary: Tall columns and brackets for an Income Tax office building.
description: Aayakar Bhavan is the Income Tax office building in Kochi. Slender dark columns with capitals rise several floors up its front, framing the windows between them.
Matching columns stand at the glazed entrance, and brackets line the underside of the projecting floor at the top.

summary: A lit showroom facade with stepped frames and jali side panels.
description: A showroom front for AGD Gold & Diamonds in Kochi, photographed at night. Stepped frames surround the brand panel on the upper floor and the entrance below it.

Ochre-coloured cladding covers the ground floor and forms a deep frame around the fins.

Ochre cladding on the ground floor and frame

description: A custom jali panel for the ISKCON temple in Coimbatore, set into a rendered wall beneath a concrete slab. A radiating floral pattern fills the square panel, with leaf motifs in the corners.

Gilded peacock at the centre

name: Renaissance Hotel
summary: Decorative screen panels set into a hotel's boundary wall.
description: Three tall decorative panels are set into the stone-clad boundary wall of the Renaissance hotel on Race Course Road, Bengaluru. Each has a pattern of overlapping circles and sits in its own frame.
Spaced along the pavement, they turn a long plain wall into a feature.

name: Manyavar

description: A bright orange fluted facade for the Manyavar clothing store in Jayanagar 4th Block, Bengaluru. Vertical flutes run the full height of the upper floors, edged with a gold-finished trim along the top and the canopy.

Balustrades follow the entrance stairs and the edge of the upper floor.
